name: Silverstone Circuit

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (Hamilton Straight ... Club), start/finish from OSM node 13036050130 raceway=start/finish; Overpass API, (c) OSM contributors ODbL
sources.width: Published/typical section widths (approximate): ~18 m Hamilton Straight/grid, 15-16 m Wellington, National and Hangar straights, ~14.5 m elsewhere, ~13 m Village-Loop-Aintree. No free UK orthophoto service used.
sources.elevation: Environment Agency LiDAR Composite DTM 1 m (2022), WCS https://environment.data.gov.uk/spatialdata/lidar-composite-digital-terrain-model-dtm-1m/wcs (OGL v3), bilinear, robust median + ~15 m smoothing
sources.camber: Crossfall from EA LiDAR DTM 1 m samples at both track edges (1.2 m inset), trackkit.profile_from_samples
sources.pit: OSM way 227902927 "International pit lane" (entry at Vale/Club, exit after Abbey/Farm)
sources.trim: High-speed flowing layout (Copse, Maggotts-Becketts, Stowe) with long straights: medium downforce, close to Spa
sources.pitLimit: FIA F1 pit lane speed limit 80 km/h (2026 British GP event notes)
sources.pitLoss: Formula1.com "Need to know" 2026 British GP: pit stop time loss ~20 s incl. 2.5 s stop
sources.raceLaps: 2026 British GP 52 laps; 2026 is a sprint weekend (Sprint 17 laps, won by Antonelli)

notes: Start/finish on the Hamilton Straight (Wing) between Club and Abbey; clockwise. Turn numbering per F1/circuit map (18 turns; Maggotts 10-11, Becketts 12-13, Chapel 14).
